description: Builds Redfish URIs locally and sends them to remote OOB controllers to perform an action.

parameters.name: auth_token
parameters.description: Security token for authenticating to iLO.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. Only used if validate_certs=true.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category to execute on OOB controller. Choices: "Systems"

parameters.name: ciphers
parameters.description: TLS/SSL Ciphers to use for the request. When a list is provided, all ciphers are joined in order with :. See the OpenSSL Cipher List Format for more details. The available ciphers is dependent on the Python and OpenSSL/LibreSSL versions.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: List of commands to execute on OOB controller.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests to iLO. Default: 60

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, TLS/SSL certificates are not validated. Set this to true to enable certificate checking. Should be used together with ca_path. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Wait for iLO Reboot Completion
  community.general.ilo_redfish_command:
    category: Systems
    command: WaitforiLORebootCompletion
    baseuri: "{{ baseuri }}"
    username: "{{ username }}"
    password: "{{ password }}"

return_values.name: ilo_redfish_command
return_values.description: Returns the status of the operation performed on the iLO. Returned: always

return_values.name: WaitforiLORebootCompletion
return_values.description: Returns the output msg and whether the function executed successfully. Returned: success

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Status of the operation performed on the iLO. Returned: success

return_values.name: ret
return_values.description: Return true/false based on whether the operation was performed successfully. Returned: success
